notes.title: Fates Call V1.1 : Optimization, bug fixes & combat rework
notes.content:
Hello everyone ! 

This is the first update of Fates Call ! 
Thank you all for your precious feedbacks 

[b]* The pixelization issue has been greatly reduced, and the game is much sharper. 
* FPS improvement 
* Companion adjustments (position, damage) 
* Some missing collision fixed
* AI of enemy & bosses has been improved (Dodge Arrows, Parry... )
* Dismemberment of enemy fixed (you’ll now see flying heads, hands and arms )  [/b]

We hope you'll enjoy the game and have a great time in Fates Call 

[b]The Team[/b]
